cards.ex: Audrey Hepburn remains a style icon for many, even decades after her death.
cards.exUz: Odri Xepbern vafotidan keyin ham ko'pchilik uchun uslub ikoni bo'lib qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Moda va uslubda o'rnak bo'ladigan, ilhom beradigan shaxs.

cards.ex: Chanel is a renowned fashion house with a rich history.
cards.exUz: Chanel - boy tarixga ega mashhur modalar uyi.
cards.uzDef: Kiyim-kechak, aksessuarlar ishlab chiqaruvchi va sotuvchi kompaniya.

cards.ex: She wore statement jewelry to add personality to her simple outfit.
cards.exUz: U oddiy kiyimiga shaxsiyat qo'shish uchun e'tiborli zargarlik buyumlarini taqdi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni tortadigan, katta va noodatiy zargarlik buyumlari.

cards.ex: She's incredibly fashion-savvy and always knows the latest trends.
cards.exUz: U moda sohasida juda bilimdon va har doim eng so'nggi trendlarni biladi.
cards.uzDef: Modani yaxshi biladigan, zamonaviy uslublarni anglaydigan.

cards.ex: Building a capsule wardrobe can simplify your life and save you money.
cards.exUz: Kapsul garderob yaratish hayotingizni soddalashtirishi va pulingizni tejashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik, ko'p qirrali kiyimlar to'plami, aralashtirish va moslashtirish oson.

cards.ex: Haute couture collections are often showcased at exclusive fashion shows.
cards.exUz: Yuqori moda kolleksiyalari ko'pincha eksklyuziv moda namoyishlarida namoyish etiladi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori sifatli, buyurtma asosida tikilgan kiyim-kechak.

cards.ex: I usually buy my clothes off-the-rack because it's more convenient.
cards.exUz: Men odatda kiyimlarimni do'kondan sotib olaman, chunki bu qulayroq.
cards.uzDef: Do'kondan sotib olinadigan, tayyor kiyim-kechak.

cards.ex: She studied textile design and now works for a major fashion brand.
cards.exUz: U to'qimachilik dizaynini o'rgangan va hozirda yirik moda brendida ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Matolar uchun naqshlar, ranglar va tuzilmalarni yaratish.

cards.ex: Color blocking is a fun way to add some vibrancy to your wardrobe.
cards.exUz: Ranglarni birlashtirish - garderobingizga rang qo'shishning qiziqarli usuli.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga mos kelmaydigan ranglarni kiyimda birlashtirish.

cards.ex: Her designs were considered too avant-garde for mainstream fashion.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynlari asosiy moda uchun juda avangard deb hisoblangan.
cards.uzDef: Noodatiy, innovatsion va eksperimental san'at yoki dizayn.

cards.ex: The color story for their summer collection is inspired by the beach.
cards.exUz: Ularning yozgi kolleksiyasi uchun ranglar hikoyasi plyajdan ilhomlangan.
cards.uzDef: Dizaynda ishlatiladigan ranglar to'plami va ularning munosabatlari.

cards.ex: The designer is known for her sculptural silhouettes and dramatic shapes.
cards.exUz: Dizayner haykaltarosh siluetlari va dramatik shakllari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Haykalga o'xshash, aniq shaklga ega kiyim silueti.

cards.ex: I need to visit the gallery to get a feel for the artist's work.
cards.exUz: Rassomning ishini his qilish uchun galereyaga borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida tasavvurga ega bo'lish, tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: A chunky necklace can be a perfect statement accessory.
cards.exUz: Katta marjon mukammal e'tiborli aksessuar bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy libosni ajratib ko'rsatadigan yorqin va diqqatga sazovor aksessuar.

cards.ex: They have some exciting new designs in the pipeline for next year.
cards.exUz: Ularda kelgusi yil uchun ajoyib yangi dizaynlar rejalashtirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Yaratilish jarayonida, yaqin kelajakda amalga oshiriladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The handmade dress was a true work of art.
cards.exUz: Qo'lda tikilgan libos haqiqiy san'at asari edi.
cards.uzDef: Oliy darajada baholangan, go'zallik va mahorat bilan yaratilgan narsa.

cards.ex: Layering different fabrics can add textural interest to an outfit.
cards.exUz: Turli xil matolarni qatlamlash kiyimga to'qimali qiziqish qo'shishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil matolar va to'qimalarni ishlatish orqali yaratilgan vizual qiziqish.

cards.ex: The overall design is good, but the devil is in the details.
cards.exUz: Umumiy dizayn yaxshi, lekin muhimi detallarda.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsaning muvaffaqiyati kichik, lekin muhim detallarga bog'liq.

cards.ex: In industrial design, the principle of form follows function is paramount.
cards.exUz: Sanoat dizaynida shaklning vazifaga bog'liqligi printsipi muhim ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Dizaynda shaklning maqsadi va vazifasi muhimroq.

cards.ex: She wanted to make a statement with her bold red dress.
cards.exUz: U o'zining yorqin qizil libosi bilan ifoda bildirishni xohladi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jalb qilish, o'z fikrini namoyish etish.

cards.ex: She dressed to kill for her job interview.
cards.exUz: U ishga kirishish uchun juda chiroyli kiyindi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni tortadigan, juda chiroyli kiyinish.

cards.ex: Modern art isn't really my cup of tea.
cards.exUz: Zamonaviy san'at men uchun unchalik yoqimli emas.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir qiziqishi, didiga mos keladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The fashion show was a feast for the eyes.
cards.exUz: Moda namoyishi ko'zni quvontirdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda go'zal, ko'rishdan zavqlanadigan narsa.

cards.ex: Her designs are always ahead of the pack.
cards.exUz: Uning dizaynlari har doim boshqalardan oldinda.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ko'ra ilg'or, zamonaviyroq.

cards.ex: I think that trend is just a passing fad.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, bu trend shunchaki o'tkinchi moda.
cards.uzDef: Tez tarqalib, tez yo'qoladigan moda yo'nalishi.

cards.ex: Fashion can be considered a visual language that expresses identity.
cards.exUz: Moda shaxsni ifodalovchi vizual til deb hisoblanishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tasvirlar, ranglar va shakllar orqali fikr bildirish usuli.

cards.ex: The designer has a cult following among fashion enthusiasts.
cards.exUz: Dizaynerning moda ixlosmandlari orasida ashaddiy muxlislari bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda sodiq va ishtiyoqli muxlislari bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Her style is all about understated elegance.
cards.exUz: Uning uslubi soddaligi bilan nafis.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, ammo nafis va jozibali uslub.

cards.ex: She has a refined taste in art and fashion.
cards.exUz: U san'at va moda sohasida nafis didga ega.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi san'at va uslubni tushunadigan va baholaydigan did.

cards.ex: He studied fine art at the university.
cards.exUz: U universitetda tasviriy san'atni o'rgangan.
cards.uzDef: Go'zallik uchun yaratilgan san'at, amaliy maqsadga ega emas.
